title: Kandil HR — Implementation and Acceptance Plan
review_limit: Read-only planning review of requirements, blueprint/change log, selected source/test modules and current custom app. Source test claims were not independently rerun. No parity acceptance or production readiness is asserted. Supplemental packages expand bundled requirements; they are not extra unique requirement counts.

phases.title: Baseline and rule decisions / تثبيت المتطلبات
phases.build: Freeze the v0.50.0 reference; reconcile 98 requirement IDs with change entries CHG-01–109, source code, forms and UAT. Break bundled requirements into testable rules. Record conflicts and source-deferred work explicitly. Map current pilot records to the target model.
phases.gate: Every baseline ID has scope, delivery phase and acceptance criteria; conflicting policies have an owner and a recorded decision before dependent work. No source Built label becomes Frappe Tested automatically.

phases.title: Secure foundation and safe commands / الصلاحيات والأساس
phases.build: Expand role/company/site/field scopes; Frappe-native identity and MFA policy; scoped delegation; command IDs, exact approval-step IDs, expected versions; audit, reliable notification outbox and clock/calendar service. Add security-sensitive account change controls. Keep optional external identity adapters separate.
phases.gate: Two companies and multiple sites cannot read each other’s protected records, files, search results or exports. Replayed approval cannot advance another step. Stale commands fail clearly; revoked access/delegation takes effect. Notification retry is deduplicated.

phases.title: Organization, positions and JDs / الهيكل والوصف الوظيفي
phases.build: Company and org-unit hierarchy, distinct Job and Position, effective-dated occupants/head roles, structure history and snapshots, grades and approved JD versions, competencies, structural-change requests, imports and position-based capacity. Preserve standard Company/Department/Designation/Employee links.
phases.gate: Import/re-import is reconciled without duplicates; position is distinct from designation; hierarchy cannot cycle; missing manager routes safely; approved JD/structure revisions remain reproducible; baseline occupied counts reconcile to an explicit allocation.

phases.title: Requests, approvals and vacancies / الطلبات والاعتمادات
phases.build: Complete HR-REC-F02; structure-derived chain, CEO/board cases, authority-specific snapshots, return/revision, reduced approvals, post-approval change requests, capacity top-ups/release, warning/block policy, priority, vacancy pause/resume/close, recruiter lead/team and unassigned queue.
phases.gate: Multiple locations, excess quantity, vacant authority, same-person steps and delegation are tested. Quantity reduction never drops below committed joins; approved changes adjust the existing vacancy safely. Concurrent requests cannot double-reserve; all balances reconcile.

phases.title: Candidates, sourcing and private journey / المرشحون والمصادر
phases.build: Person master linked to multiple applications and later employment; phone-only/shared-phone rules; reviewed duplicate resolution, source/sub-source, advertisements, subscription credits, referrals/agencies, imports, talent pool, former-employee checks, versioned consent, private candidate links, activities, next actions and rejection communication.
phases.gate: One person can have multiple applications; a shared phone never forces an automatic merge. Imports are previewed and replay-safe. Expired/revoked tokens fail; candidate A cannot access candidate B; sensitive fields and internal rejection reasons do not leak. Manual copy is not reported as sent.

phases.title: Assessments, interviews and selection / التقييم والمقابلات
phases.build: Practical tests, competencies/question versions, manager-confirmation gates, panel roles/waivers, candidate confirmation, arrival/waiting events, blind feedback, comparison/readiness, selected/reserve states, reference checks, conflict-of-interest declarations and deadline escalation.
phases.gate: Invitation cannot bypass confirmation; each interviewer cannot view another’s answers before authorized release; salary/photo restrictions apply to forms and APIs. Rescheduling invalidates obsolete reminders; no-show and incomplete-panel cases resolve with evidence.

phases.title: Compensation, offers and printed forms / العروض والمستندات
phases.build: Versioned grade bands and incentive schemes; five-stage salary trail; calculated fixed package, authority thresholds and exceptions; negotiation/reapproval, validity/extensions, payroll-supervisor review of estimated net; offer/contract/salary-detail templates, working hours and weekly rest fields.
phases.gate: Boundary values route to the correct approver; changes after approval require the agreed revision policy. Internal incentives and pay-only fields cannot leak to candidate/interviewer outputs. Arabic/English PDF renders correctly; missing mandatory template inputs block issuance. No actual payroll deduction or payment occurs.

phases.title: Joining, files, onboarding and insurance / المباشرة والتهيئة
phases.build: Joining-date history; document matrix, versions, review/receipt, waivers/deferrals, non-waivable rules and expiry; actual joining/no-show, audited correction; Employee and employment linkage; configurable onboarding tasks, IT/admin/safety owners, custody/PPE, social-insurance cases, welcome gift and new-hire surveys.
phases.gate: Concurrent joining creates one intended employment event and correct headcount; mandatory documents follow the approved policy. Correction reverses dependent effects without deleting history. Joining opens each required case once. Deferred documents cause follow-up, never wage withholding.

phases.title: Probation, movement and exit / الاختبار والنقل والخروج
phases.build: Goals/acknowledgment, probation reviews and PIP, final recommendation/decision, employee view, medical-insurance case, stay interview; permanent/temporary transfer, receiving-manager initiation, scheduled effect/return, handover and replacement; two-person exit and rehire continuity.
phases.gate: Controlled clock verifies checkpoints, weekends and overdue paths; no duplicate probation on rehire under the agreed employer rule. Transfer moves occupancy once on its effective date. Temporary cover preserves the home position correctly; exit revokes accounts and reallocates open work.

phases.title: Reports, insights and assisted CV review / التقارير والذكاء المساعد
phases.build: Operational reports, role dashboards/inboxes, KPI formulas and drill-down, recruiter scorecards, source ROI, bottlenecks, interviewer calibration, forecast with history sufficiency indicators. AI CV extraction/evidence, human-reviewed suggestions, redaction, quotas/cost limits, provider errors and audit.
phases.gate: Metrics reconcile to a hand-calculated synthetic dataset, respect scopes and handle zero denominators. Low-data forecasts are labeled insufficient. AI output is reviewed, cannot authorize a hiring decision, rejects instructions embedded in CVs, and observes configured payload/cost limits.

phases.title: Integration, acceptance and controlled rollout / الاختبار والتشغيل
phases.build: Complete provider adapters and live smoke tests where configured; payroll-file import/SSO/short-link source-deferred items tracked separately. Role-based native-browser UAT, Arabic/mobile/print review, migration rehearsal, restore and upgrade drill, realistic load, operator runbook, HR/admin/user guides and readiness dashboard.
phases.gate: All agreed requirement subcases have implementation and evidence, critical defects closed, HR acceptance recorded, seed-free production migration rehearsed and restore proven. Sandbox integrations remain labeled sandbox until live verification. No real cutover based on local test counts alone.
